description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Uncanny Dodge temporal talent or class feature

Benefit: A time mage with this talent can no longer be flanked. This defense denies a thief the ability to sneak attack the character by flanking him, unless the attacker has at least four more levels in a class that grants sneak attack than the time mage's class level. If a character already has uncanny dodge from another class, the levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum level in a class that grants sneak attack required to flank the character.

system.requirements: Uncanny Dodge temporal talent or class feature
